PAI_LIVE_1.brand_logic: Use the custom field T2."U_Brand". DO NOT join the OMRC table.
PAI_LIVE_1.location_logic: Always group/select branch locations using COALESCE(OWHS."U_Location", OWHS."WhsName").
ai_prompt_exclusions: Carry bags / packing items: LOWER(T1."ItemCode") NOT LIKE '%carry%' AND LOWER(T1."Dscription") NOT LIKE '%carry bag%'

DEFAULT.brand_logic: Join T2 to OMRC on T2."FirmCode" = OMRC."FirmCode". Use OMRC."FirmName" for brand.
DEFAULT.location_logic: Use OWHS."City" or OWHS."WhsName" for branch locations.
